WITH station_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    o.observstation,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) as telescope_count
  FROM observatories o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON o.observstation = t.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(telescope_count AS FLOAT)) as avg_tele_count
  FROM station_stats
)
SELECT 
  s.observstation,
  s.avg_bandwidth,
  s.telescope_count,
  CAST(s.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / a.avg_tele_count as ratio
FROM station_stats s, avg_count a
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
